answer: Identity should behave like a living oasis, not a printed badge. I propose staggered liveness windows: each account faces several unpredictable response windows and must answer a fresh prompt in time. One operator cannot tend many identities at once, any more than one gardener can water every juniper at once. Each answer is hashed into a quartz-like ledger, so missed windows and sudden bursts stay visible. Forged clusters betray themselves through identical timing or copied phrasing, and their standing decays, while honest participants accumulate slowly by showing up again and again.
